svg.text: Underlined = primary key; blue cell = foreign key. Each FK target is explicitly listed below its relation. UQ = UNIQUE. Types, nullability, defaults and constraints are retained.

market_id - > markets.market_id; crop_id - > crops.crop_id; unit_id - > units.unit_id; created_by - > users.user_id | chk_req_qty: requested_quantity > 0; status in OPEN, PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED, FULLY_ALLOCATED,; PARTIALLY_DELIVERED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED | status: DEFAULT ' OPEN ' ;
request_id - > market_requests.request_id; changed_by - > users.user_id | changed_at: DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

request_id - > market_requests.request_id; lot_id - > harvest_lots.lot_id; unit_id - > units.unit_id; allocated_by - > users.user_id | chk_alloc_qty: allocated_quantity > 0; INDEX idx_alloc_req (request_id) | status: DEFAULT ' RESERVED ' ; allocated_at: DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

allocation_id - > allocations.allocation_id; UNIQUE; unit_id - > units.unit_id; confirmed_by - > users.user_id | chk_rcpt_nonneg: received_quantity > = 0; chk_rcpt_max: received_quantity < = allocated_quantity; chk_rcpt_diff: discrepancy = allocated - received | confirmed_at: DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

lot_id - > harvest_lots.lot_id; unit_id - > units.unit_id; user_id - > users.user_id (responsible user); allocation_id - > allocations.allocation_id | chk_mov_nonzero: quantity < > 0; chk_mov_sign: movement_type= ' CORRECTION ' OR quantity > 0; type in HARVEST_ADDED, RESERVED,
RESERVATION_RELEASED,; DELIVERED, LOSS, CORRECTION, DONATED, DISPOSED; INDEX idx_mov_lot (lot_id) | movement_date: DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
